closes_with: a host mapping in AnyPS5's C++ (e.g. shm_open to the host's shm_open), witnessed by AnyPS5's ctest on Linux and Windows
name: derivable_standard_host
statement: Fixed by a public standard (C, POSIX, FreeBSD, ELF, RFC), but an effect on the host (processes, shared memory, events, file system, sockets): it belongs in AnyPS5's effect shell, mapped to the host API (CM21).
